import 'dart:io';

/// The sum of [sizes].
int total(List<int> sizes) {
  var sum = 0;
  for (final size in sizes) {
    sum += size;
  }
  return sum;
}

/// Whether a job of [size] may be taken with the limit [limit].
bool fits(int size, int limit) => size >= 0 && size <= limit;

/// How many pages [lines] lines take with [perPage] on each.
int pages(int lines, int perPage) => (lines + perPage - 1) ~/ perPage;

/// [size] within [least] and [most].
int within(int size, int least, int most) =>
    size < least ? least : (size > most ? most : size);

/// How many jobs wait in the directory [path]: its files, without the notes
/// (`.note`) and without what is not yet unpacked (`.part`). None in a
/// directory that is not there.
int waiting(String path) {
  final folder = Directory(path);
  if (!folder.existsSync()) {
    return 0;
  }
  var count = 0;
  for (final entity in folder.listSync()) {
    if (entity.path.endsWith('.note')) {
      continue;
    }
    if (entity.path.endsWith('.part')) {
      continue;
    }
    count++;
  }
  return count;
}
